names: UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center
summary: UCSF's June 2025 presentation to the Mission Bay Citizens Advisory Committee lists Block 18C among its undeveloped parcels remaining, with open space as the long-term use and a childcare center as the near-term use. That matches this record's status of existing, not yet redeveloped: a childcare center operates on the block now, on ground UCSF still counts as undeveloped. Bright Horizons lists the UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center at 727 Nelson Rising Lane, a city business registration and the city's address point for that address place it here.

DataSF's official address point for 727 Nelson Rising Ln (address ID 743045, parcel 8711007) lies inside this record's outline, 2.7 m from its nearest edge (Pier & Point's own calculation). It is a frontage point, not a building footprint, and the same address also carries a UCSF shuttle-fuelling registration (Booster Fuels, certificate 1106713, location start 2026-05-28), so the address alone does not single out the childcare center.

open_questions: Is a childcare building standing on Block 18C today? A childcare center is registered and addressed here, and UCSF names a childcare center as 18C's near-term use while still counting the block as undeveloped, but no source read gives the building's footprint or says when it was built or opened.
'Operating since 2006' (in the geometry file notes) was not found on either Bright Horizons page read; no opening or construction date for the center was found.

OCII's December 2019 Land Use Map text shows plan blocks 18A and 18B on this row and no 18C; the block number comes from UCSF's own list. How UCSF's 18C relates to OCII's plan blocks was not resolved from text.
No developer, architect, owner of the building or cost was found.
